content.text: Loading Skip to Main Content Search HomeDepartments & OfficesTransit & Commuter ServicesRider InformationTraffic Alerts for Drivers Traffic Alerts for Drivers There are several ways that Loudoun County motorists can keep up to date on road conditions.Alert LoudounAlert Loudoun is the notification system Loudoun County uses to send citizens emergency information, news releases, traffic information, weather alerts, and more through texts and emails. One of the most popular categories of Alert Loudoun is "Loudoun Traffic and Road Closures." Stay on top of what's happening on Loudoun roads by signing up for traffic alerts.Capital AlertIf you live in Loudoun but work in another jurisdiction in the National Capital Region, you can easily sign up for alerts from that county or municipality through the Capital Alert system. Traffic Incident MapThe Traffic Incident Map provides users with real-time traffic-related data. The map combines information from the Loudoun County Sheriff’s Emergency Communications Center, ESRI, Google Traffic and the Waze app.Loudoun County Traffic Incident Activity MapVirginia 511The Virginia Department of Transportation provides real-time information about traffic and road conditions through the Virginia 511 system .
